entities.name: Johannes Prassek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Prassek was a German Catholic priest, and one of the Lübeck martyrs, guillotined for opposing the Nazi regime of Adolf Hitler in 1943. Prassek was beatified by Pope Benedict XVI in 2011.
